title: ochlandra travancorica
intro: Ochlandra travancorica, commonly known as Travancore lanceolate, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ochlandra travancorica include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
